zh: 单独占一个通道的包，它的中位数就是自己；要让总和最大，应该让最大的包尽量独占通道。
可以证明最优方案中至多只有一个通道包含多个包：把最大的 k−1 个包各自独占一个通道，剩下的所有较小的包合成最后一个通道，取它的中位数。
排序；remaining=n−k+1 个最小的包组成一组，记 j=remaining/2，两倍中位数为奇数个时 2·a[j]，偶数个时 a[j−1]+a[j]；答案为最大 k−1 个包之和加上 (两倍中位数+1)/2（即 0.5 向上取整）；用 64 位整数，全程整数运算避免浮点。
en: A packet alone in a channel has itself as the median, so to maximize the total the largest packets should get channels of their own.

An optimal plan can be shown to have at most one channel with several packets: give each of the k-1 largest packets its own channel and put all the remaining smaller packets in the last channel, taking its median.

Sort; the remaining = n - k + 1 smallest packets form one group; with j = remaining / 2, twice the median is 2*a[j] for an odd count and a[j-1] + a[j] for an even count; the answer is the sum of the k-1 largest packets plus (twice the median + 1) / 2, which rounds .5 up. Use 64-bit integers and integer arithmetic only, no floating point.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Give each of the k-1 largest items its own channel and put the remaining smaller items together in the last channel. Add the solo values and the median of the last group, using twice-the-value integers to avoid floating point.

## Proof of correctness

If there are two multi-item groups, the larger element behind the higher of their medians can be promoted to a solo group and the remaining elements merged into the other group; comparing the medians by ordered pairing shows the total does not decrease. Repeating this leaves at most one multi-item group; taking the largest k-1 items as solos is optimal, and the remaining group contributes its median.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
